title: רב אמי בר אדא הרפנאה

paragraphs: Rav Ammi bar Adda of Harpanya asked Rabbah, who replied: Adda bar Ahavah said in Nachman’s name in Shmuel’s name. But Eruvin 59, end of b: Rabbah answered in Rav’s name; Rav Nachman said, “Do not listen: Rav Adda said in Rav’s name.” Thus Yuchasin has some error, or another reading before him.
